capabilities: Sync vault markdown notes to Notion as child pages of a parent page
Detect created, changed, and deleted notes via sha256 hashes and update or archive pages accordingly
Authenticate with a Notion integration token or an OAuth public integration
Schedule automatic syncs at a set interval or trigger them manually
Restrict syncing to selected vault folders
extras: Desktop-only. Credentials are stored in ~/.config/akbun-notion-sync with 0600 permissions, outside the vault, to avoid leaking tokens via git or cloud sync. OAuth setup requires the user to create their own Notion public integration, including a privacy policy URL; the integration-token method is offered as the simpler alternative.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push vault notes into Notion or keep those Notion pages in step with local edits and deletions.

relations.evidence: syncs every markdown note in your vault to Notion as child pages of a parent page

summary: Sync tool that mirrors every markdown note in a desktop vault to Notion as child pages, creating, updating, and archiving them based on content hashes.
